methods.name: Wavelet Neural Operator (WNO)
methods.protocol_description: WNO uses discrete wavelet transform (DWT) to decompose input snapshots into high and low frequency components. An information subset is created using wavelet coefficients at higher levels of decomposition. The network parameters are learned in the wavelet space. The architecture consists of four WNO layers activated by GeLU. Mother wavelet from Daubechies family (db6, db4, etc.) is used. Training uses ADAM optimizer with initial learning rate 0.001, weight decay 1e-6, learning rate decay by 0.75 every 50 epochs. Batch size varies between 10-25. Experiments run on single RTX A2000 6GB GPU.
